basis: The kind map r2 (pinned in previous) with contextual entries for the 1:n node kinds that the class-B alternatives of csharp-B03 and csharp-B04 use. An entry gives the types of a kind by the Roslyn kind of its direct parent. Authored from the pinned grammar.js alone (grounds); no native output.

grammar.limit: The vocabulary is the pinned upstream node-types.json plus the four named node types the repository's C2 patch (src/dev/c2-patches/csharp.json) adds and the registered case expectations already use. Other node types the patch chain may add are not enumerated; the generated parser is not read.

spec: C# standard draft v13 as published at learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/language-specification (dotnet/csharpstandard alpha-v13, commit 79ad4e90ef63; the ECMA-334 successor text): 6.4.4 keywords, 6.4.5 literals, 6.4.6 operators and punctuators, 12 expressions, 13 statements, 14-19 declarations
tree-sitter-c-sharp grammar.js and src/node-types.json at the pinned commit

contextual.reason: grammar.js builds with_initializer only in the body of a with expression; an assignment anywhere else is assignment_expression, and the object initializer holds assignment_expression nodes
